Ond's first beta. It tries out updates that install themselves, so the next beta can arrive the new way. Everything else is as in 0.6.0.

Ond 0.6.0 and other full releases don't offer betas. To try this one, download it below.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.1-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on x86_64, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, same requirements |
| `Ond-0.7.0-beta.1-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10 and 11 |

The `.minisig` files are signatures. Ond checks a download against them before it installs an update.

### Updates

- Settings › About has a Channel row. Releases offers only full releases; Betas offers the newest version, beta or full release. Until you choose, a beta follows Betas and a full release follows Releases.
- When an update is out, Download fetches and checks it, and Restart to Update installs it. Quitting installs it too, without reopening Ond.
- Install updates automatically, off by default, downloads each update when it's found and installs it the next time you quit.
- Ond installs updates itself from the macOS app in Applications (or another writable folder), from a Linux archive installed with `install.sh`, and from the Windows zip. Elsewhere, such as a copy run from the dmg, it links to the release page as before. A Nix install doesn't look; Nix updates it.
- Home Manager can set both: `updates = "install"` and `update_channel`, in [docs/home-manager.md](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/ond-v0.7.0-beta.1/docs/home-manager.md).

### Please report

If an update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Ond, and that message.
